item.title: Situating India in Entrepreneurship Scholarship: Indigenous Insights and Global Relevance
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks to advance entrepreneurship scholarship by centering Indian contexts and perspectives. The call invites research that explores entrepreneurial phenomena within India while examining how indigenous insights can contribute to global entrepreneurship theory and practice.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing Insights. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
